breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt incorrectly stated to assume the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The ground truth removes this physically incorrect assumption. The generated specification also correctly omits this erroneous instruction and instead includes the correct calculation for torsional shear stress (`τ = T c / J`) and its use in the plane stress analysis (`τxy = τ`), thus resolving the inconsistency.
